dn6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
dn6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā vesāliyaṃ paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
dn6:1.4: assosuṃ kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā,
dn6:1.5: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
dn6:1.6: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn6:1.7: ‘iti’pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
dn6:1.8: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
dn6:1.9: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
dn6:1.10: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
dn6:2.1: atha kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
dn6:2.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
dn6:2.3: atha kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā yenāyasmā nāgito tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ etadavocuṃ:
dn6:2.4: “kahaṃ nu kho bho nāgita, etarahi so bhavaṃ gotamo viharati?
dn6:2.5: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamanti.”
dn6:2.6: “akālo kho āvuso, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. paṭisallīno bhagavā”ti.
dn6:2.7: atha kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā tattheva ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu:
dn6:3.1: oṭṭhaddho’pi licchavī mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā yenāyasmā nāgito tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho oṭṭhaddho’pi licchavī āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ etadavoca:
dn6:3.2: “kahaṃ nu kho bhante nāgita, etarahi so bhagavā viharati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho?
dn6:3.3: dassanakāmā hi mayaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.”
dn6:3.4: “akālo kho mahāli, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. paṭisallīno bhagavā”ti.
dn6:3.6: “disvā va ahaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ gamissāmi arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhanti.”
dn6:4.1: atha kho sīho samaṇuddeso yenāyasmā nāgito tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ‘ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sīho samaṇuddeso āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ etadavoca:
dn6:4.2: ete bhante kassapa, sambahulā kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā idhūpasaṅkantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. oṭṭhaddho’pi licchavi mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ idhūpasaṅkanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya. sādhu bhante kassapa labhataṃ esā janatā bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā’ti.
dn6:4.4: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho sīho samaṇuddeso āyasmato nāgitassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sīho samaṇuddeso bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn6:4.5: “ete bhante sambahulā kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā idhūpasaṅkantā bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, oṭṭhaddho’pi licchavī mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ idhūpasaṅkanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
dn6:4.6: sādhu bhante labhataṃ esā janatā bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
dn6:4.8: “evaṃ bhante’ti kho sīho samaṇuddeso bhagavato paṭissutvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ āsanaṃ paññāpesi.
dn6:4.9: atha kho bhagavā vihārā nikkhamma vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn6:5.1: atha kho te kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu.
dn6:5.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
dn6:5.3: oṭṭhaddho’pi licchavī mahatiyā licchaviparisāya saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho oṭṭhaddho licchavī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: “purimāni bhante, divasāni purimatarāni sunakkhatto licchaviputto yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etadavoca:
dn6:5.4: ‘yadagge ahaṃ mahāli, bhagavantaṃ upanissāya viharāmi na ciraṃ tīṇi vassāni, dibbāni hi kho rūpāni passāmi piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni. no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāmi piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyānī”ti.
dn6:5.5: santāneva nu kho bhante sunakkhatto licchaviputto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni udāhu asantānī”?
dn6:5.7: “santāneva kho mahāli, sunakkhatto licchaviputto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni no asantānī”ti.
dn6:6.1: “ko nu kho bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena santāneva sunakkhatto licchaviputto dibbāni saddāni nāssosi piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no asantānī?”ti.
dn6:6.2: “idha mahāli, bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savaṇāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:6.3: so puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savaṇāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.
dn6:6.4: puratthimāya disāya dibbāni rūpāni passati piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, no ca kho dibbāni saddāni suṇāti piyarūpāni kāmūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni.
dn6:6.6: evaṃ hetaṃ mahāli, hoti bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ekaṃsabhāvite samādhimhi dibbānaṃ rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ, no ca kho dibbānaṃ saddānaṃ savaṇāya piyarūpānaṃ kāmūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.

dn6:12.1: “etāsaṃ nūna bhante, samādhibhāvanānaṃ sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ carantī”ti.
dn6:12.2: na kho mahāli, etāsaṃ samādhibhāvanānaṃ sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:12.3: atthi kho mahāli, aññe’va dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca, yesaṃ sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ carantīti.
dn6:13.1: katame pana te bhante, dhammā uttaritarā ca paṇītatarā ca, yesaṃ sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ carantīti.
dn6:13.2: idha mahāli, bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
dn6:13.3: ayaṃ’pi kho mahāli, dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.4: puna caparaṃ mahāli, bhikkhu tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
dn6:13.5: ayampi kho mahāli, dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.6: puna caparaṃ mahāli, bhikkhu pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī, anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
dn6:13.7: ayampi kho mahāli, dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.
dn6:13.8: puna caparaṃ mahāli, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
dn6:13.9: ayampi kho mahāli, dhammo uttaritaro ca paṇītataro ca yassa sacchikiriyāhetu bhikkhū mayi brahmacariyaṃ caranti.

dn6:14.1: “atthi pana bhante maggo, atthi paṭipadā etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyā?”ti.
dn6:14.2: “atthi kho mahāli, maggo, atthi paṭipadā, etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyā”ti.
dn6:14.3: “katamo pana bhante maggo, katamā paṭipadā, etesaṃ dhammānaṃ sacchikiriyāyā?”ti.
dn6:14.5: seyyathidaṃ? sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
dn6:14.6: ayaṃ kho mahāli maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā, etesaṃ sacchikiriyāya.
dn6:15.3: maṇḍisso ca paribbājako jāliyo ca dārupattikantevāsī yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā mama saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
dn6:15.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho te dve pabbajitā maṃ etadavocuṃ.
dn6:15.5: “kinnukho āvuso gotama, taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ? udāhu aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīra?”nti.
dn6:16.1: “tena hāvuso, suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmī”ti.
dn6:16.2: “evamāvuso”ti kho te dve pabbajitā mama paccassosuṃ.
dn6:16.4: idhāvuso, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho [yathā sāmaññaphale
dn6:16.5: evaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] …pe… tassime pañcanīvaraṇe pahīne attani samanupassato pāmojjaṃ jāyati. pamuditassa pīti jāyati. pītimanassa kāyo passambhati. passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti. sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. so vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. so imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti. seyyathāpi āvuso, dakkho nhāpako vā nhāpakantevāsī vā kaṃsathāle nhānīyacuṇṇāni ākiritvā udakena paripphosakaṃ paripphosakaṃ sandeyya. sāyaṃ nhānīyapiṇḍi snehānugatā snehaparetā santarabāhirā phuṭā snehena na ca paggharaṇī. evameva kho āvuso, bhikkhu imameva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati. nāssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti.
dn6:16.8: yo nu kho āvuso, bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ nu kho tassetaṃ vacanāya
dn6:16.9: taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti’vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti’vā?ti.
